# laravelcloud_database_snapshots (Resource)

Manages a snapshot of a Laravel Cloud database cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_database_snapshots" "example" {
  database = "database-id"
  name     = "example-name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) The database this resource belongs to.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `database_snapshot` (String) The database snapshot identifier
- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `completed_at` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `pitr_enabled` (Boolean)
- `pitr_ends_at` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `storage_bytes` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_database_snapshots.example database-id/the-id
```
